text: Follow-up from 020-S closure (docs/closure/2026-11-11-020-S-review-and-closure.md): add a POSIX-only test asserting the 0o700 directory and 0o600 file modes created by internal/capture; QUALITY_SCORE.md grades the package B until it exists

Follow-up from 020-S closure (docs/closure/2026-11-11-020-S-review-and-closure.md): add a Windows CI job so Windows-only tests run outside developer machines; ci.yml currently builds the Windows executable on ubuntu-latest only

Follow-up from 020-S closure (README Self-update note): release.yml builds only windows/amd64 and windows/arm64 assets, so teams-cli update returns ErrAssetNotFound on Linux and macOS; decide whether to publish non-Windows release assets or document Windows-only support
